jungle_tracking.advice: Enemy jungler likely finishing their first full clear. Expect a gank from the river/tri-brush. Ward now.
First Grubs are active. If you have a lead, shove wave and help your jungler secure them. They are Yorick's best friend.

objective_priority.advice: Stay for Turret Plates until 14:00. Yorick takes towers faster than anyone. Only leave for Grubs if your jungler is being invaded.
Do not die for a CS. Use E to farm from distance. Give up the tier 1 turret if it prevents a dive.

matchup_strategy.advice: Stay healthy until Level 3. Use your W (Cage) to force their Dash. If they dash, hit E and all-in. They are squishy.
Never trade without 4 ghouls. Respect their 'Zone of Death'. You outscale them after 1 item.
